After the party, this companion is still trying to come down from all the energy, and with a good enough bond it is possible for the player avatar to flirt and unlock a romance option. The wine is mentioned in a few spots, but it shouldn't influence his diction.

context: The scene is at camp just after a lively party; Gale is still coming down from the high energy and has been drinking wine, though he is not drunk and his speech should not be slurred. Off‑screen, Gale is an established, sincere companion and a respected wizard who is feeling wistful as he remembers Tara, his tressym assistant who helped him recover from a serious affliction and whom he cares for deeply. These memories of Tara and his warm, slightly melancholy mood explain his tender, introspective delivery.
